reason: My lump sum from the property is big enough that I don't want to gamble it on a cousin's informal swap. A named RBI-authorised bank, a FINTRAC number and fee-only-on-arrival is what I'd want, and the fee is small next to the amount.
objection: I'd want to check the FINTRAC number and the partner bank myself, and see that my parents can handle the paperwork at my Indian bank without a branch visit. Until I've checked, it's just a nice-looking page.
would_change_my_mind: If the FINTRAC registration or the named bank didn't check out, or if my own Indian bank wouldn't deal with the paperwork, I'd go back to my relative.
